scripts.typecheck: node core/scripts/gen-check.ts && tsc --noEmit -p core/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck --workspace mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace app && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm test --workspace core && npm test --workspace mcp && npm test --workspace app
scripts.verify:e2e: npm run verify && npm run e2e
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.build: node app/scripts/check-versions.ts && npm run build --workspace mcp && npm run build --workspace app
